name: Marketing Council
subtitle: Marketing strategy council
description: Route the brief to the right marketing skill before choosing tactics. Marketing Council packages 29 focused skills with cross-functional fallback, specialist agents, evidence gates, commercial checks, and measurable decision workflows.
starter_prompts: Diagnose this marketing problem and route it to the right specialist skill.
Run a council debate on this strategy and make one defensible commercial decision.
Red-team this marketing plan, then rebuild the parts that would fail commercially.
